phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to compare things using comparatives and superlatives, and how to talk about quantity with countable and uncountable nouns.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. My car is faster than yours. This is the biggest city in the country. There is some milk. There are many apples. Notice -er/-est for short adjectives, more/most for long adjectives.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: This book is ___ than that one.
phases.explanation: For long adjectives we use more + adjective + than.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Compare two cities you know: which is bigger, more beautiful, more expensive?

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: She is the ___ student in the class.
phases.explanation: Good is irregular. Its superlative is best.
